storm.note: Hourly shape approximated: most of the 153 mm (24 h to 08:30 on 9 July, Safdarjung) fell during the day (126.1 mm between 08:30 and 17:30 as reported). Each spot is scaled by distance-weighted 24-hour totals from 4 IMD stations.
